reels.title: MambaAct: Efficient Mamba Action Experts for Flow-Matching Vision-Language-Action Models

editorial_notes.reasoning: MambaAct provides a high-velocity intersection between hardware efficiency and robotics. The transition from heavy Transformers to Mamba-based architectures is a perfect candidate for 3b1b-style geometric visuals, and the efficiency gains in real-time control have massive appeal for both developers and robotics enthusiasts.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: Why are our robots still 'laggy' when making decisions, and could a new state-space shortcut be the key to instant reflexes?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: Comparing a slow, heavy library-search process (Transformer) to a streamlined, 'on-the-fly' muscle memory reflex (Mamba).
